name: retro-triage
description: Triage a skill's session retro (retro.md / improvement backlog) into reviewed, version-bumped skill edits and a PR. Use when the user hands you a retro (file path or pasted) plus the skill they're working on — "triage the retro for <skill>", "/retro-triage", "apply the retro to my skill", "turn retro.md into a PR", "work through the retro one by one". Treats the retro as CANDIDATES not decisions: reads the whole target skill first, distills distinct candidates, gets approval one-by-one (each with a recommended option + reasoning via AskUserQuestion), reconciles against the skill's own refuted/learned notes, then implements surgically in a worktree and ships a PR without bloat.
